d:
A three-part exclusive by ThePrint shows how Chinese satellites made unusual manoeuvres days before the Pahalgam attack on April 22, 2025. It also reveals that China-Pakistan satellites are watching every part of India very closely & that during Operation Sindoor, three Chinese satellites changed their usual orbits to focus on Gujarat coast.
In special edition of Ep 1942, ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta and Senior Assistant Editor Soumya Pillai explain the significance of Pakistan-Space cooperation, and the implications for India.
